m.aarti.tek: Victory, victory to you, divine Gorakh. Show me your grace, that I may serve you every day.
m.aarti.pad1: On your head are very beautiful matted locks, and the moon shines on your forehead; earrings gleam in your ears, and the mind is enchanted to see them.
m.aarti.pad2: Round your neck is the selī, a serpent gracing it, and you wear ash on your body; you are the primal Person, the lord of yogīs, the benefactor of the saints.
m.aarti.pad3: You alone are the stainless Lord, who dwells in every heart; you show grace to your own and undo the noose of Yama.
m.aarti.pad4: Ṛddhi and Siddhi lie at your feet, and Māyā is your servant; you are the unseen avadhūta (the ascetic free of every tie), who dwells in Uttarākhaṇḍa.
m.aarti.pad5: Beyond reach, beyond the senses, beyond words and without form, you stand apart from all; you alone are ever the protector of yogīs.
m.aarti.pad6: Brahmā and Viṣṇu sing your virtues night and day; Nārada, Sarasvatī and the gods together fix their minds on your feet.
m.aarti.pad7: In all four ages you are present, in the body of a yogī; in the Satya, Dvāpara, Tretā and Kali ages you have taken away fear.
m.aarti.pad8: Whoever sings the āratī of Guru Gorakhnāth night and day, so the child Trilokī prays, gains the fruit of liberation.
